uncited: Unlike physically accurate methods that solve for multiple scattering, these models use heuristic shading terms, blurred indirect light, or hybrid surface-volume compositing to simulate translucency and atmospheric effects at interactive rates [4109, 12114].
The hybrid approach addresses limitations of traditional isosurface rendering by capturing the full volume extent [12114].
The empirical model addresses the computational bottleneck of multiple scattering by using heuristic approximations [4109].
